Run an existing enabled task automation once now by jawbone_id, using its saved prompt and delivery settings without changing its schedule. Use only when the user asks for an immediate run. Look up the task with peek if its ID is unknown. Supports ordinary cloud-scheduled tasks. Success confirms the run was requested, not that execution or delivery has completed.
